text_block_list.text: The final night of the summer training camp—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...The last sparkler just went out.
choice_data_list: That was over in a flash, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But—
...it turned into a lovely memory♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer-kun.
It feels a bit too early to head straight home...
...Care to take a little walk with me?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer-chan.
It feels a bit too early to head straight home...
...Care to take a little walk with me?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Besides, the moon is pretty tonight.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Shall we walk for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "...Fufu♪ Thank you."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...We're already heading back to the academy tomorrow, aren't we?
choice_data_list: ...And soon, the autumn season will begin.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
......And regarding that, well—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: There's a race after the QEII Cup that I'd like to consult you about.
choice_data_list: ...Is there a race you want to run?
...Is there a race you want to run?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since you helped strengthen the love
between me and my community, Trainer-kun,
there's a goal I've always wanted to take on."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Ever since you helped me deepen my love with all my followers, Trainer-chan, there's been a goal I've wanted to challenge.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I—
want to run with Ai-san.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And if it's at all possible...
I want to compete in the race where Eye-san showed her power two years ago...
The Japan Cup...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since the Japan Cup the year before last,
Ai-san has been the very symbol of 'the strongest' to me."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Being together in Dubai, and then racing
together in the Victoria Mile, only made
that impression grow stronger and stronger."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Even in these uncertain times, Ai-san...
she purely seeks victory, and it's so dazzling—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
To me...
she was an Umamusume who possessed all the strength I lacked.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Still, that was only the case until recently.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've realized my own strength...
I truly, genuinely want to challenge Ai-san.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And after earning the reputation of being the strongest in Japan...
I want to take off onto the world stage as Japan's representative...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Well, even so, we still don't know
if Ai-san is going to run in this year's
Japan Cup yet, though.
choice_data_list: Still, I think aiming for it in itself is a wonderful thing.

text_block_list.text: Even if Almond Eye doesn't run, Loves Only You securing a good result in the Japan Cup holds immense significance.
choice_data_list: Let's head to the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks♪
...So you're not going to stop me from competing with Ai-san, huh?
choice_data_list: They're already competing, after all. Besides—

text_block_list.text:
If it's Loves Only You, she can surely hold her own in any Japan Cup.
She can even win against Almond Eye.
choice_data_list: Because I believe you're the strongest.
Because I believe that you're the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...It's really not fair when you do that.
choice_data_list: —Still, the Queen Elizabeth II Cup comes first.
—Still, the Queen Elizabeth II Cup comes first.

text_block_list.text: It has already been decided that Lucky Lilac will run in this year's Queen Elizabeth II Cup, just like last year...

I have to settle the score with the one who
gave Loves Only You her baptism by fire
in the Senior class...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—That's true.
I'll definitely show Lara-san as well.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: That my running is different from last year...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Isn't she so cool~?
Your most beloved trainee Umamusume♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ Cool, right~?
Your most lovely trainee Umamusume, that is♡

The summer night passes, and autumn approaches.
—Autumn, the season of decisive battles.
